nsw_t1-47n_queued_cars.desc: three queued cars from behind with red tail lights: the T1-47n symbol (same symbol detail on these sheets), scaled to the stated box

notes: TfNSW plan T1-47-1n (Roads & Maritime 2019 sheet, 1:15, text outlined): size (B) 1680 x 1260 drawn ((A) 1200 x 900 also on the sheet; the largest is generated). Square corners, black border 35 ('35' corner mark) and a black 35 divider centred on x 840; left panel yellow with the queued-cars symbol 700 x 492 at 70 from the left, 384 from the top (70 / 700 / 70, 384 / 492 / 384); right panel red with white PREPARE 140 C (78 / 682 / 80 from x 840), TO 140 D (318 / 204 / 318), STOP 140 D (202 / 437 / 202), tops 280 / 560 / 840 (280 / 140 / 140 / 140 / 140 / 140 / 280), centred on the red half (x 1260). Drawn on a black ground with the coloured panels as rectangles.
